mode: Invoke the existing separately provisioned FFmpeg executable; no FFmpeg C source copied or linked into TypeScript
binaryLicense: Depends on the actual FFmpeg build. The existing tested essentials binary enables GPL/version3; its distribution obligations remain with that separately distributed component.
provenance: Every C3 identity records actual FFmpeg/FFprobe hashes and executable version; reviewed source tag alone does not certify arbitrary replacement binaries.
originalCode: Parameter/selection/lifecycle glue and RMS-rise candidate rules are original Apache-2.0 repository code. These candidates are not a borrowed musical beat recognizer.
